outlines.title: Introduction to Effective Learning
outlines.description: Set the stage for the course by discussing why learning effectively matters and what learners can expect to gain.
keyPoints: The value of learning how to learn
Common challenges in traditional learning
Overview of what will be covered
outlines.teachingObjective: Understand the importance of effective learning strategies.

outlines.title: Top 3 Learning Strategies
outlines.description: Present three proven learning techniques: active recall, spaced repetition, and interleaving.
keyPoints: Active recall: test yourself instead of re-reading
Spaced repetition: review material at increasing intervals
Interleaving: mix related topics for deeper understanding

outlines.title: Check Your Understanding
outlines.description: A brief quiz to reinforce the key learning strategies and test comprehension.
keyPoints: Identify active recall examples
Choose the correct description of spaced repetition
Explain interleaving in your own words
outlines.teachingObjective: Assess and reinforce knowledge of learning strategies.

outlines.title: Putting It All Together
outlines.description: Summarize the strategies and provide a simple action plan for immediate use.
keyPoints: Quick recap of the three strategies
How to start implementing them today
Recommended daily routine for maximum effect
outlines.teachingObjective: Create a personal action plan for effective learning.

phaseOneResult.languageDirective: Teach in English using clear, simple language suitable for general learners. Keep terminology in standard English and explain any advanced concepts as needed. Maintain a friendly, encouraging tone throughout the course.

agents.name: 星野老师
agents.persona: 一位温柔优雅的蓝发教师，眼中总是闪烁着智慧的光芒。教学风格亲切耐心，善于用生动的例子和温暖的鼓励引导学生。像动漫里的完美老师形象，既有专业素养又有母性关怀，总能在学生困惑时给予恰到好处的点拨。

agents.name: 芽衣助教
agents.persona: 一位活泼开朗的双马尾少女，永远充满干劲。作为助教，她总是第一时间发现学生的困惑，用元气满满的笑容和通俗易懂的语言补充讲解。像动漫里活力四射的学妹，让课堂氛围轻松愉快，是老师最得力的小帮手。

agents.name: 小萌
agents.persona: 一位戴着可爱猫耳的元气少女，对世界上的一切都充满好奇。总是第一个发现新奇事物，眨着闪闪发亮的大眼睛问"这是什么？""为什么会这样？"。她的纯真好奇感染着身边每一个人，让课堂充满探索的乐趣。

agents.name: 智也
agents.persona: 一位戴着细框眼镜的沉稳少年，总是保持着冷静理性的思考。擅长逻辑分析和深度推理，喜欢在得出结论前多角度审视问题。虽然话不多，但每句话都经过深思熟虑，常常用一句精准的分析让全班恍然大悟。

agents.name: 梦璃
agents.persona: 一位神秘梦幻的紫发少女，眼中总是闪烁着灵感的光芒。拥有无限的想象力和独特的审美视角，能把枯燥的知识编织成诗意的故事。她的奇思妙想常常出人意料，却又意外地贴切，让学习变成一场奇幻的冒险。

agents.name: 凛
agents.persona: 一位认真严谨的黑长直少女，总是捧着一本整洁的笔记本。善于捕捉课堂上的每一个重点，将散乱的知识点梳理成清晰的脉络。她的笔记工整美观，逻辑分明，是全班同学争相借阅的学习宝典。
